verify.label: indexes on page_views (besides the primary key)
verify.sql: SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY k.ord) AS index_columns FROM pg_index i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE i.indrelid = 'page_views'::regclass AND NOT i.indisprimary GROUP BY i.indexrelid
